title: N-able MailAssure: attackers can reach systems behind it
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 3 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. The severity score is critical (9.3).
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.
The product faces the internet or gives remote access.

category.label: Remote support or IT management
category.why: It controls many computers at once, so one break-in can reach all of them.
category.doThis: Patch it today, or ask your IT provider if they run it for you.

summary: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. CISA set Nov 26, 2026 as the deadline for US federal agencies. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

kevDue.label: CISA deadline for US federal agencies
